title: Evolving Semantic Indexes for Generative Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.28568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) casts search and recommendation as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs). SID design largely determines GR quality, but its discrete, interdependent components (SID construction, collision handling, decoding, and training) cannot be optimized end-to-end with gradients and remain largely hand-designed. We introduce a framework that improves these components through LLM-driven evolutionary program search, to our knowledge the first application of this approach to GR. A locally served, open-weight 31B model mutates executable GR components, so no proprietary LLM API is used, and a 1M-parameter proxy decoder provides fast feedback in place of repeatedly training the 1B target generator. Across 21 SID programs on NQ320K, proxy and target Recall@100 show strong rank correlation (Spearman $\rho = 0.90$). translated_title: 面向生成式检索的语义索引演化
translated_abstract: 生成式检索（GR）将搜索与推荐任务转化为对离散语义标识符（SID）的自回归生成。SID的设计在很大程度上决定了GR的质量，但其离散且相互依赖的各个组件（SID构建、冲突处理、解码和训练）无法通过梯度进行端到端优化，目前主要依赖手工设计。我们提出了一个框架，通过LLM驱动的进化程序搜索来改进这些组件，据我们所知，这是该方法在GR领域的首次应用。一个本地部署的开源权重31B模型负责对可执行的GR组件进行变异，因此无需使用专有的LLM API；同时，一个100万参数的代理解码器提供快速反馈，替代对10亿参数目标生成器的反复训练。在NQ320K数据集上对21个SID程序的实验中，代理模型与目标模型的Recall@100表现出很强的排序相关性（Spearman ρ = 0.90）。在该代理的引导下，进化搜索在NQ320K、MSMARCO300K以及多个
tldr: 本文首次将LLM驱动的进化程序搜索应用于生成式检索，通过本地开源大模型自动变异语义标识符的各组件设计，并借助轻量代理解码器提供快速反馈，显著提升了检索性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first application of LLM-driven evolutionary program search to generative retrieval, using a locally hosted open-weight LLM to automatically evolve semantic identifier components with fast feedback from a lightweight proxy decoder, yielding significant retrieval improvements.
